name: DO NOT ENTER
spec: white square with a red circle and a white horizontal bar, legend DO NOT ENTER in black above and below the circle
meaning: Do not drive in; you would be going the wrong way.

snippets.back: Enter a reversible lane only as its control signal permits, and do not enter if the lane-control signals are dark.
Do not enter a gap so small that the available safety cushion can quickly disappear.

Obey red-and-white orders like DO NOT ENTER, retreat from WRONG WAY signs, red night reflectors confirming; yellow-black circles and Xes mark rail crossings, pentagons schools, diamonds dangers, rectangles rules.

A flashing yellow arrow lets a left-turning driver go carefully only after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians; it then turns solid yellow, meaning do not enter if you can stop safely, and finally red, meaning stop.
For a vehicle fire, stop in an open place away from vegetation, buildings and other vehicles, and do not enter a service station.
Beacons supplementing Stop or Do Not Enter signs are red.

Yield requires slowing and giving crossing vehicles the right-of-way, proceeding slowly without stopping if clear; Do Not Enter bars entering one-way streets and roadways, whereas Wrong Way requires turning around immediately; a red circle and slash prohibits the pictured action; and Speed Limit, Exit Speed, and active school or work zone doubled-fine signs regulate speed.
Do not enter a railroad crossing without enough room to drive completely through it without stopping. Once safely committed, keep moving across the tracks.

result.summary: FL states Do Not Enter bars entering one-way streets and roadways, supporting the wrong-way meaning; no snippet describes the white square/red circle/white bar/black legend shape.
